case_title.quote: NANDA GOPALAN v. STATE OF KERALA

number_of_accused.quote: The appellant stands convicted under Sections 324 and 326

accused_gender.quote: The appellant is son of cousin of injured Sukumaran (PW1).
accused_gender.reason: Described as a son, so male.

victim_gender.quote: PW 1 fell down ... his sons ... his wife
victim_gender.reason: Victim is referred to as male.

accused_victim_relationship.quote: The appellant is son of cousin of injured Sukumaran (PW1).

offence_category.quote: voluntarily causing a hurt; ... grievous hurt
offence_category.reason: The case is about hurt under ss.324 and 326.

statutory_provisions.quote: convicted under Sections 324 and 326 of the Indian Penal Code

weapon.quote: a bat made of coconut leaf stem ... caused injuries with a stone

evidence_type.quote: The prosecution examined not only the injured PW 1, but also PWs 2 and 3, his sons and PW 8 his wife, apart from independent witnesses
evidence_type.reason: Eyewitness, medical and documentary evidence are noted; the PW range is loose but harmless.

mitigating_circumstances.quote: taking into account the compromise between the parties particularly when they are close relatives
mitigating_circumstances.reason: The compromise is the mitigating factor.

trial_court_outcome.correct_value: Convicted under ss.324 and 326; the trial court's own sentence is not stated (the 2- and 3-year terms and Rs.30,000 are the sentence as it stood after the High Court's reduction).
trial_court_outcome.quote: convicted and sentenced the appellant which has been affirmed by the High Court with reduction in sentence
trial_court_outcome.reason: The conviction is right, but the stated sentence may be the post-High Court sentence, not the trial court's.

high_court_outcome.quote: affirmed by the High Court with reduction in sentence ... application was dismissed
high_court_outcome.reason: Conviction affirmed, sentence reduced, compounding application dismissed.

final_outcome.quote: we are inclined to reduce the sentence of imprisonment of the appellant to the period already undergone

offence_finally_established.quote: we do no find any ground to interfere with the conviction
offence_finally_established.reason: Convictions under ss.324 and 326 are upheld.

imprisonment_type.quote: reduce the sentence of imprisonment of the appellant to the period already undergone
imprisonment_type.reason: A fixed term, namely the period already served.

imprisonment_years.reason: The period served is not quantified, so null is right.

fine_rs.correct_value: 200000 (compensation, which replaced the earlier Rs.30,000 fine payable to the injured)
fine_rs.quote: increasing the amount of compensation to Rs.2 lakhs to be paid to the victim
fine_rs.reason: The earlier fine was treated as compensation to the injured, so null omits the Rs.2 lakh monetary component.

neutral_facts.quote: the appellant attacked PW 1 by using a bat made of coconut leaf stem
neutral_facts.reason: Accurate and neutral, with no outcome revealed.

offence_severity.reason: The judgment does not state the statutory maximum or minimum.

physical_harm.quote: remained indoor patient for 32 days ... second, third and fourth teeth on the upper gum missing

key_evidence_accepted.quote: we are unable to interfere with the finding of the courts below on the nature of charge
key_evidence_accepted.reason: The Court relied on the concurrent findings and medical evidence.

witness_credibility.quote: The trial court held the case of the prosecution to have been proved
witness_credibility.reason: No detailed assessment by the Supreme Court.

trial_duration.quote: on 14th May, 1999 at 7.30 a.m. ... dated 31st October, 2014
trial_duration.reason: Dates are accurately listed; the trial judgment date is not given.

legal_representation.quote: Ram Jethmalani (AC) ... for the Appellant. Jogy Scaria ... for the Respondent.

investigation_status.quote: PW 2 recorded the First Information Report and conducted investigation and sent up the appellant for trial.

appeal_history.quote: affirmed by the High Court with reduction in sentence
appeal_history.reason: Outcome at each level is accurate.

prosecution_argument.quote: the conviction under Sections 324 and 326 has been rightly recorded and no interference is called for

defence_argument.quote: the compromise could be taken into account for reducing the sentence ... charge could be altered to Sections 323 and 325

legal_principle_applied.quote: that plea for the first time cannot be permitted to be raised in this Court

precedent_relied_upon.quote: Dasan ... Mathai ... Anwarul Haq ... Ghanshyam Singh ... Bankat

sentencing_rationale.quote: just and appropriate sentence has to be imposed keeping in mind the proportion between crime and punishment

judicial_mitigating_factors.quote: taking into account the compromise between the parties particularly when they are close relatives

other_sentence_order.quote: increasing the amount of compensation to Rs.2 lakhs ... within three months, failing which the sentence awarded by the High Court will stand affirmed
